verdicts.originalText: Flowfire Blade enters a Nightsoul's Blessing state (NS Blessing) for up to 12s — Traveler is the only non-Natlan character to use the Nightsoul system. NS drains at 7 points/sec from a max of 42 (so 6s base duration if you don't refresh). Burst refreshes 7 NS up to 4 times. Authored as `behavior: stance + opensState: nightsoulBlessing` with duration: 12 (the timed cap from gcsim EnterTimedBlessing). The drain mechanic and NS-refresh are not separately modeled.
verdicts.proposedText: Shown for the full 12s, but the Nightsoul state drains at 7 points/sec from a max of 42 — empty in about 6s unless refreshed. The burst restores points up to 4 times; the drain and refresh are not modeled.
verdicts.rationale: Compressed to the one real divergence: the Nightsoul state is drawn for the authored 12s cap but in game drains to empty in ~6s without refresh, and the burst's point refresh isn't modeled. Dropped the 'only non-Natlan character' trivia and the schema/gcsim authoring detail (banned tokens: backticked identifiers, gcsim, field names). Stripped the ability name 'Flowfire Blade' and character name 'Traveler' since the panel shows both. The drain and refresh are unconsumed-trigger mechanics the engine cannot model (the burst curator note confirms refresh 'doesn't fit a clean trigger primitive'), so this stays a legitimate divergence caveat, not implementDelete.
